about: Breadcrumbs — where this page sits: the pages above it, each a link, from the top of the site down. Use for: sites more than two levels deep, where a reader may arrive from search and want to go up a

items.about: The pages above this one, from the top of the site down. Each is a link.

current.about: This page's name, as the last crumb. Not a link, and marked as the current page. Leave it out when the page's heading sits right under the trail and says the same thing.

label.about: The landmark's name. "Breadcrumb" unless the page has a second trail.

collapse.about: On a narrow box, show only the way up: the parent, as a back link. On by default; turn it off where the whole trail is short enough to wrap.
